title: Codka Aamusnaanta ee Qolka
intro: Duco ayaa ka soo yeedhaysa xasilloonida qol barakeysan waqti dheer ka hor, iyadoo ka soo kacaysa naf gabowday oo u xiisaynaysa waxa adduunku ku dhawaaqay wax aan macquul ahayn. Tiradan, oo da'deedu sii kordheyso oo ay ku cuslaatay welwelka mustaqbalka, ayaa u jeestay Rabbigooda iyagoo duco shaqsiyeed u samaynaya. Waxa xigay waxay ahayd jawaab rabbaani ah oo ka hor imaanaysa rajo kasta oo dabiici ah - markhaati u ah naxariista Kan ka jawaabaya baaqa quusta ah.
clues: Waxaan Rabbigeyga si gaar ah ugu yeeray, anigoo u baxay qol aan ku dadaalay cibaadada.
Waxaan u qirtay Rabbigeyga inaan ka baqay kuwa iga dambeeya, anigoo ka walwalsan hagitaanka dadkayga marka aan baxo.
Gabow ayaa i qabsaday—lafahaygu way daciifeen timo cadna madaxayga ayay ku fideen.
Xaaskaygu waxay ahayd madhalays nolosheeda oo dhan, haddana weli waxaan Rabbigay ka baryay inuu i siiyo dhaxal ka yimid hortiisa.
Waxaan codsaday calaamad, Rabbigeyna wuu ii jawaabay isagoo iga hor istaagay inaan qof la hadlo saddex habeen, anigoo jir ahaan caafimaad qaba.
Waxaa la ii ballan qaaday wiil magaciisa la odhan doono Yaxya, magac uu Rabbigey ku dhawaaqay oo aan hore loo siinin.

trial.answer: Ducada dhaxalka gabowga ah ee xaaska madhalayska ah

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
